tools.name: elationhealth_list_patients
tools.description: Search the practice's patient charts (PHI): id, name, date of birth, sex, contact details, address, status. First and last name match exactly (case-insensitive, no partial names). The SSN is redacted. Elation: GET /patients/.

tools.name: elationhealth_get_patient
tools.description: Get one patient chart header by id (PHI): demographics, contact details, address, insurance, emergency contact, primary physician, tags. The SSN is redacted. Elation: GET /patients/{id}/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments and calendar time slots, filterable by date range, patient, physician and practice. Each has the scheduled date, duration, status, reason, patient, physician and service location. Elation: GET /appointments/.

tools.name: elationhealth_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id: scheduled date, duration, status, reason, instructions, patient, physician, practice, service location, telehealth and billing details. Elation: GET /appointments/{id}/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_appointment_types
tools.description: List the appointment types (visit reasons with default duration) a practice offers. Elation: GET /appointment_types/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_practices
tools.description: List the practices this API key can access: id, name, address, status, time zone, physicians and service locations. Elation: GET /practices/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_physicians
tools.description: List the practice's physicians (providers): id, name, NPI, specialty, credentials, license, practice, user id. Elation: GET /physicians/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_problems
tools.description: List one patient's problem list (PHI): description, ICD-9/ICD-10/SNOMED codes, status (Active, Controlled, Resolved), start and resolved dates, synopsis. Elation: GET /problems/?patient=.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_allergies
tools.description: List one patient's allergies (PHI): allergen name, reaction, severity, status, start date. Elation: GET /allergies/?patient=.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_medications
tools.description: List one patient's medication documents (PHI): drug name, strength, directions, quantity, authorized refills, prescribing physician, start date, and the discontinue order if any. Current and discontinued entries both appear unless you filter. Elation: GET /medications/?patient=.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_visit_notes
tools.description: List one patient's visit notes (PHI): visit date, type, physician, signed state and the note body (bullets by category such as Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan). Filter by signed date or last change. Elation: GET /visit_notes/?patient=.

tools.name: elationhealth_get_visit_note
tools.description: Get one visit note by id (PHI): visit date, type, physician, signed state and the full note body. Elation: GET /visit_notes/{id}/.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_non_visit_notes
tools.description: List one patient's non-visit notes (PHI): free-text chart notes outside a visit, such as phone calls and administrative notes. Elation: GET /non_visit_notes/?patient=.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_vitals
tools.description: List one patient's vital signs (PHI): height, weight, BMI, blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, temperature, oxygen saturation, pain, with chart dates. Elation: GET /vitals/?patient=.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "elationhealth_list_physicians" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the practice's physicians (providers): id, name, NPI, specialty, credentials, license, practice, user id. Elation: GET /physicians/.
